summary: Moonbase Architect – Mission 2050 is an interactive space survival and lunar base-building simulation game. Players take on the role of a space architect and design a sustainable human settlement on the Moon. They must build essential systems in the correct sequence, including site survey, solar power, water extraction, oxygen production, radiation shielding, crew habitat, thermal control, and food production. The game uses building dependencies and a scoring system to demonstrate why proper planning and resource management are essential for future lunar exploration. It aims to make space engineering concepts engaging and accessible through interactive gameplay.
details: Moonbase Architect – Mission 2050 Project Overview Moonbase Architect is an interactive educational simulation game that explores the challenges of establishing a sustainable human settlement on the Moon. How It Works Players take the role of a lunar base architect. They must construct eight essential infrastructure modules in a logical sequence: 1. Site Survey – Identify a suitable location for the lunar base. 2. Solar Power Array – Establish a reliable energy supply. 3. Water Extraction Plant – Secure access to water resources. 4. Oxygen Production Plant – Produce breathable oxygen. 5. Radiation Shielding – Protect the habitat from radiation exposure. 6. Crew Habitat – Establish a pressurized living environment. 7. Thermal Control – Maintain suitable temperature conditions. 8. Food Growth Laboratory – Support long-term food production. Each building has specific prerequisites. Constructing a module without completing its required systems results in a scoring penalty. Main Features - Interactive lunar base construction. - Sequential building and dependency logic. - Energy, oxygen, and water resource indicators. - Mission scoring and progress tracking. - Warnings for incorrect construction sequences. - Final crew-readiness assessment. Technology Used The project is developed using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. It runs directly in a web browser without requiring additional software installation. Innovation and Impact The game transforms complex lunar settlement planning concepts into an accessible interactive experience. It encourages players to understand the importance of infrastructure planning, life-support systems, resource management, and sustainable space exploration. Future Improvements Future versions could include realistic lunar terrain data, more detailed resource simulations, additional missions, improved 3D environments, and expanded scientific models. Note: This is an educational prototype using simplified engineering rules, not a scientifically validated lunar habitat design.
